d: Patna ke maner men shukravar ahle subah hue bhishan enkauntar ke bad ab danapur anumandal aspatal ranakshetr men tabdil ho gaya. maner muthbher men mare gae 3 kukhyat apradhiyon (raja sharma, bablu kumar aur jepi yadav) ke shavon ko jab postamartam ke lie danapur aspatal laya gaya, to parijnon ke sath bhari sankhya men bhir jama ho gaee.
